transformations.rel_hum: col K, dropouts→interp, clip[1,100], hourly mean
transformations.wind_dir: col L, vector (u,v) hourly mean to avoid wrap
transformations.pressure: col Q (MSL hPa) → zeros interpolated → ×factor(z=18.0 m)→station → ×100 → Pa
transformations.dew_point: derived from T,RH via Magnus (WMO a=17.62,b=243.12)
transformations.solar: col O (GHI, ÷10-corrected) → Erbs decomposition (pvlib) → DNI+DHI; REQUIRED for EnergyPlus solar gains
transformations.hour_convention: EPW hour h = interval ending h:00 (right edge)

policy: All EPW fields measured or derived by named transforms; none invented.
